rendered: Under the US Advanced Battery Consortium standards, an EV battery reaches the end of its usable life when its current cell capacity is less than[1] 80%[2] of its rated capacity. Such end-of-life batteries can be reused/repurposed, recycled, or[3] (reuse covers a second life in applications such as grid energy storage; disposal in landfills is the third option, which the review says would cause serious environmental issues). The review states that regardless of whether batteries are reused, they will eventually need to be[4] recycled.
